description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

UST is seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications. The role works with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, reliable solutions and supports APIs, integrations, backend services, and application quality and performance.
Software Engineer designing, developing, and maintaining applications, APIs, and backend services from business requirements through deployment

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software applications
• Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
• Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following coding standards and best practices
• Participate in code reviews and ensure software quality
• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues
• Collaborate with product managers, architects, QA teams, and stakeholders
• Develop APIs, integrations, and backend services as required
• Optimize application performance, scalability, and security
• Create and maintain technical documentation. Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
• Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, or Go
• Experience with object-oriented design principles and software development methodologies
• Knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, and web technologies
• Experience with databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB
• Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools
• Understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
• AI Coding Agents, AI Mentor Studio, AI FinOps
